method: We compared the zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers with the highest certified smoke CADR per watt, weighing efficiency, smoke CADR and the five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). The CleanAirKits Luggable Ultra (5-fan) (certified as Rainbow Luggable Ultra, record 4518200) is left out: its certified yearly energy and its CADR per watt disagree, so one of the two printed numbers would be wrong. Change on 2026-11-04: we found the maker's Amazon listing for the DREAME CVA10B and added it. Its five-year electricity cost is the lowest on this page and each criterion scores against the page's best, so the other models' cost points fell: the CleanAirKits Luggable XL Ultra (7-fan) stays #1, but its lead over #2 narrowed from 3.2 to 1.5 points, the deciding number moved from electricity cost to CADR per watt, and the LEVOIT LAP-C311S-WUSR left the top 10.
name: The most energy-efficient air purifiers, ranked mainly by certified CADR per watt
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

excluded.why: conservative choice: only units that report 0 ppb ozone in certification; UL's zero-ozone test (UL 2998) cannot quantify low readings, so this also drops units whose small non-zero reports are not reliably different from 0

excluded.filter: certified yearly energy far from what its own smoke CADR and CADR per watt imply
excluded.why: yearly energy, smoke CADR and CADR per watt are linked on almost every record of this list; where they disagree this much the record contradicts itself, so neither its running cost nor its efficiency can be trusted

selection.label: Smoke CADR per watt
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields
